slides.title: The Science of You
slides.text: Hidden Forces Driving Your Every Move
slides.speech: Twins sharing 100 percent of their DNA provide critical data for determining if your personality is born or made. Human behavior is a complex response to internal and external stimuli, driven by a battle between genetic blueprints and environmental pressures. This encompasses many domains, from cognitive learning to physiological actions that keep your body functioning. While social norms pressure you into acceptable conduct, your economic behavior dictates how you use materials, and digital interactions are currently reshaping your social relationships. Even moral decisions and religious practices are specific types of behavior studied to find meaning. Researchers analyze these patterns using neurobiology to understand how the nervous system controls action.
